title: Northern Irish Seaweed Salad
description: A refreshing and healthy salad made with Irish seaweed, northern greens, and vibrant vegetables.
instructions: Rinse the Irish seaweed and pat it dry with a paper towel.
Chop the vibrant lettuce and Irish cabbage into bite-sized pieces.
Shred the carrots into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the seaweed, lettuce, cabbage, and carrots.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
